method: Rv0678 CDS (NC_000962.3:778,990-779,487) translation; first-stop region DBD<=99 / mid 100-160 / late>160; high-confidence LoF excludes single-nt homopolymer indels; late-stop preserves dimerization domain (Snobre function-preserving proxy).
interpretation: Snobre's susceptible-frameshift fraction REPLICATES in this lineage mix: 0.2504 (162/647) vs reported 0.248. DBD-break truncations dominate; 43 late variants are function-preserving candidates.
caveats: ARF conservation approximated by late-stop preservation (full phylogenetic ARF alignment out of scope). Homopolymer indels flagged low-confidence (e.g. 193_del_g). Whole-gene deletion = full_del. A sample carrying multiple regions is counted in each.
supports: First predictive integration of truncation-position reasoning for BDQ (to our knowledge); descriptive replication of Snobre 2024.
